note_en: The only Discord account of the run 1 pair is Timmy's 10 June drylab report. It names B. subtilis 168 for the 1 June flask curves and then describes the reactor pair run the same day without naming a strain, so the chassis of runs 1 and 2 is still not recorded. Ask Chars or Gabriel, who ran them.
note_zh: Discord 中唯一談到第一次反應器實驗的紀錄，是 Timmy 於 6 月 10 日在 drylab 頻道的回報。該則訊息為 6 月 1 日的搖瓶曲線標明菌株為 B. subtilis 168，但接著描述當天的反應器配對實驗時並未寫出菌株。因此第一、二次實驗的菌株仍無紀錄，建議詢問執行的 Chars 或 Gabriel。

evidence.quote: 20260601 Growth curve of B.sub 168 in normoxia and hypoxia cunditions.

note_en: 94 mL/min appears in Discord as a vendor figure, not a measurement: the 4 July hardware specification Timmy posted as authoritative gives the hollow-fibre module throughput as 94 mL/min at a wall shear of 2000 per second. That is the likely origin of the run 1 flow number, which fits the note that no June flow record exists.
note_zh: 94 mL/min 在 Discord 中出現的身分是廠商規格，而非量測值。Timmy 於 7 月 4 日張貼、標示為權威版本的硬體規格寫明中空纖維模組在壁面剪切 2000 s⁻¹ 時流量為 94 mL/min。這很可能就是第一次實驗流量數字的來源，與六月沒有流量紀錄的情況相符。

evidence.quote: - Throughput: <750 mL rated; 94 mL/min @2000 s⁻¹, 282 mL/min @6000 s⁻¹

note_en: Ethan's 21 August comparison of all the growth runs puts every short test between 0.198 and 0.921 per hour, which brackets the 0.309 per hour flask fit, and describes the short lumen test as never rising above noise over five hours, which matches a reactor fit of about zero. The fitted numbers themselves are not in Discord.
note_zh: Ethan 於 8 月 21 日比較所有生長實驗，指出每一次短程實驗的生長率介於 0.198 至 0.921 每小時之間，涵蓋了搖瓶的 0.309；他並說短程 lumen 實驗五小時內始終未高於雜訊，與反應器擬合近於零一致。不過擬合數值本身並未出現在 Discord。

evidence.quote: Every short test: 0.198 to 0.921 h⁻¹
Short lumen test: never rises above noise the entire 5h

note_en: Timmy's 10 June drylab report says the run 1 pair was run in the incubator at 22 degrees, so the number was a set temperature on the incubator and not an ambient room reading. The wiki's wording of room temperature does not match that description.
note_zh: Timmy 於 6 月 10 日的 drylab 回報寫明第一次實驗的兩組都放在 22 度的培養箱中，因此 22 °C 是培養箱的設定溫度，而不是室溫量測值。維基上寫成室溫與這段描述不符。

evidence.quote: Today they did another pair of B.sub growth curve test but both in the incubator 22 degress.

note_en: Ethan's 21 August survey of the dataset puts every short test between 0.198 and 0.921 per hour. A reactor fit of 1.195 per hour sits outside that range, so either his survey left the run 2 reactor fit out or the two analyses disagree. Worth checking with Ethan before the number is used.
note_zh: Ethan 於 8 月 21 日整理整批資料時，把所有短程實驗的生長率列為 0.198 至 0.921 每小時。反應器 1.195 每小時落在這個範圍之外，表示他當時未納入第二次實驗的反應器擬合，或兩份分析彼此不合。使用這個數字前建議先向 Ethan 確認。

evidence.quote: Every short test: 0.198 to 0.921 h⁻¹

note_en: Noah announced on 21 July, the day the long run started, that the photometer was running in the incubator on the lowest shelf. That settles the incubator part of the claim; no message gives the incubator setting, so 22 °C is still unsourced.
note_zh: 長程實驗開始當天，Noah 於 7 月 21 日公告光度計正在培養箱最下層運轉，證實了實驗確實在培養箱中進行。但沒有任何訊息提到培養箱的設定溫度，因此 22 °C 仍無出處。

evidence.quote: we have our photometer running in the incubator on the lowest shelf

note_en: The only cross-run comparison in Discord is Ethan's on 21 August, and it gives a 6 to 56 fold span between the long run and the short tests, which he sums up as a 50 fold difference. No message gives a factor of 28, so that number still has no source.
note_zh: Discord 中唯一的跨實驗比較是 Ethan 於 8 月 21 日所做，他給出長程實驗與短程實驗之間 6 至 56 倍的差距，並總結為 50 倍。沒有任何訊息提到 28 倍，因此這個數字仍無出處。

evidence.quote: 1. Growth rate — 6–56× slower

note_en: Chars's 29 August forecast lists a pSTK-EXP1-Csn:ACCD liquid culture prepared for the bioreactor test, which fixes the construct used in run 4. The chassis is not named there, and the neighbouring ACCD lines in the same entry are WB800 work, so 168 is not confirmed by the wet lab record.
note_zh: Chars 於 8 月 29 日的預告列出為反應器測試準備的 pSTK-EXP1-Csn:ACCD 液體培養，確定了第四次實驗所用的構築。但該處未寫出宿主菌株，而同一則紀錄中鄰近的 ACCD 項目都是 WB800 的工作，因此濕實驗紀錄並未確認 168。

evidence.quote: D. pSTK-EXP1-Csn:ACCD liquid culture (for bioreactor test)
C. ACCD from WB800 SDS-PAGE, Coomassie Blue staining and Western blot.

note_en: Discord settles this against Biomanufacturing. The July reactor run was still logging past 200 hours, as Ethan noted on 21 August when he described the long run growing noisier past about 200 h, and Noah had started it in the incubator on 21 July. A 102.4 h September run therefore cannot be the longest; the Biomanufacturing wording is wrong.
note_zh: Discord 的紀錄站在 Biomanufacturing 的對立面。七月那次反應器實驗記錄時間超過 200 小時：Ethan 於 8 月 21 日提到長程實驗在約 200 小時之後雜訊變大，而 Noah 是在 7 月 21 日把它放進培養箱開始的。因此九月那次 102.4 小時的實驗不可能是最長的一次，Biomanufacturing 的寫法有誤。

evidence.quote: Long run: increasingly noisy past ~200h (±0.3 OD spread near plateau)
we have our photometer running in the incubator on the lowest shelf

note_en: Noah set out both numbers in the figure caption he drafted on 5 September: the hydraulic characterisation establishes a 300 mL/min ceiling and the selected operating point is 263 mL/min at a TMP of 0.30 bar. The 385 mL/min in the 2 September sampling instruction is a separate wet lab instruction and remains unexplained.
note_zh: Noah 於 9 月 5 日草擬的圖說同時寫出這兩個數字：流體力學特性量測訂出 300 mL/min 的上限，選定的操作點為 263 mL/min、跨膜壓 0.30 bar。9 月 2 日取樣指示中的 385 mL/min 屬於另一份濕實驗指示，仍未獲解釋。

evidence.quote: Hydraulic characterisation of the hollow-fibre module establishes a 300 mL/min operating ceiling.
Star marks the selected operating point (263 mL/min, TMP 0.30 bar).

note_en: Discord shows where both molecular weights come from. The 4 July hardware specification gives ACCD as about 36 kDa in its note on what the 0.2 µm pore passes, while Chloe, reporting a team blot on 21 September, reads the ACCD monomer at 38 to 42 kDa. The 36 kDa figure is a spec note; the band reading supports about 42 kDa.
note_zh: Discord 顯示兩個分子量各自的出處。7 月 4 日的硬體規格在說明 0.2 µm 孔徑可通過什麼時，把 ACCD 寫為約 36 kDa；而 Chloe 於 9 月 21 日回報團隊的轉漬結果時，把 ACCD 單體讀為 38 至 42 kDa。36 kDa 屬規格註記，實際條帶判讀支持約 42 kDa。

evidence.quote: - CAVEAT: 0.2 µm passes ACCD (~36 kDa) but also small OMVs / cell debris;
the band length is around 63 kDA [monomer length is around 38-42 kDA]

note_en: Discord shows DNPH material in circulation in October: Timmy posted a DNPH ACCD protocol to the drylab channel on 7 October, and on 12 October Sophie Huang listed DNPH wiki writing among her tasks. No DNPH result and no Berthelot result was posted, so which assay produced which number is still unanswered.
note_zh: Discord 顯示十月間確實有 DNPH 的資料在流通：Timmy 於 10 月 7 日在 drylab 頻道張貼 DNPH 的 ACCD 操作文件，Sophie Huang 於 10 月 12 日把 DNPH 的維基撰寫列入自己的工作。但沒有任何 DNPH 或 Berthelot 的結果被貼出，因此哪個數值來自哪種方法仍未釐清。

evidence.quote: DNPH wiki writing

note_en: The 4 July hardware specification gives the module pore size as 0.2 µm and states that B. subtilis cells, quoted there as 1 to 2 µm, are fully retained. That matches Biomanufacturing's 1 to 2 µm rods; the 0.25 to 1.0 µm diameter on the wiki has no counterpart in Discord.
note_zh: 7 月 4 日的硬體規格寫明模組孔徑為 0.2 µm，並指出 B. subtilis 細胞（文中引為 1 至 2 µm）會被完全截留。這與 Biomanufacturing 所寫的 1 至 2 µm 桿菌一致；維基上的 0.25 至 1.0 µm 在 Discord 中找不到對應來源。

evidence.quote: - Retention: B. subtilis cells (1–2 µm) fully retained → biocontainment intact

note_en: Chars posted the raw file for this measurement on 18 August, two days after the test, saying he used a pressure transducer and a flow meter and attaching 260816_pressure_to_flow_rate.xlsx. He also says the accompanying PDF analysis was produced by Claude, which is where the reported numbers were first worked out. Nothing records how long each pump setting was held.
note_zh: Chars 於 8 月 18 日、即實驗兩天後貼出原始檔，說明他用壓力傳感器與流量計取得資料，並附上 260816_pressure_to_flow_rate.xlsx。他同時說明隨附的 PDF 分析是由 Claude 產生的，報告中的數字最初就是這樣算出來的。沒有任何紀錄說明每個泵設定維持了多久。

evidence.quote: Here is the experiment result of flow rate to pressure measure. I used pressure transducer and flowmeter to obtain the data. The Excel is the data and pdf is the result analysis by claude.

note_en: On 5 September Noah was still writing 0.90 to 0.96 times theory for 113 to 263 mL/min in his own figure caption, which is the progress-report side of this conflict, not the later 1.03 times. Chars's 18 August post shows the first analysis of the 16 August data was a Claude-written PDF, so the change most likely came from a reanalysis rather than new measurement.
note_zh: Noah 於 9 月 5 日在自己的圖說中仍寫 113 至 263 mL/min 區間為理論值的 0.90 至 0.96 倍，也就是進度報告那一側的數字，而非後來的 1.03 倍。Chars 於 8 月 18 日的貼文顯示，8 月 16 日資料的第一份分析是由 Claude 產生的 PDF，因此差異較可能來自重新分析而非新的量測。

evidence.quote: Measured points agree with Hagen–Poiseuille theory (teal dashed) to within 0.90–0.96× from 113–263 mL/min
The Excel is the data and pdf is the result analysis by claude.

note_en: Two things in Discord bear on this. The 4 July hardware specification, posted as the authoritative build record, gives the module as 150 cm² with 8 fibres of 1.0 mm bore and says it replaces an earlier 200 cm², 11-fibre record, so the nominal 11 is in doubt. Noah's 5 September caption says the shear rate computed from flow and from pressure agree to within 10%, which is the basis for the effective fibre count.
note_zh: Discord 中有兩點與此有關。7 月 4 日張貼、作為權威建置紀錄的硬體規格把模組寫為 150 cm²、8 根內徑 1.0 mm 的纖維，並註明取代先前 200 cm²、11 根纖維的紀錄，因此標稱 11 根有疑問。Noah 於 9 月 5 日的圖說則指出由流量與由壓力各自計算的剪切率相差在 10% 以內，這正是有效纖維數的依據。

evidence.quote: - Filtration area: 150 cm²; 8 fibers; lumen ID 1.0 mm

Wall shear rate γ, computed from flow and geometry (Route 1) and from measured pressure drop (Route 2, geometry-independent), agrees to within 10% across the operating range — confirming the assumed fibre count and bore.

note_en: Noah's 5 September caption gives a different pair of ratios for the same fit: 0.90 to 0.96 times theory across 113 to 263 mL/min, then 1.26 times above 300 mL/min. The wiki's 0.83 times at 113 and 1.27 times at 450 must come from a later recomputation, which nobody describes in Discord.
note_zh: Noah 於 9 月 5 日的圖說對同一條擬合給出另一組比值：113 至 263 mL/min 為理論值的 0.90 至 0.96 倍，300 mL/min 以上則為 1.26 倍。維基上 113 mL/min 的 0.83 倍與 450 mL/min 的 1.27 倍應出自後來的重新計算，但 Discord 中沒有人描述這次重算。

evidence.quote: then diverge to 1.26× above 300 mL/min as header minor losses grow

note_en: The roughly 200 mL figure is a measured lumen volume, not an estimate: on 13 May Chars reported measuring and cleaning the hollow-fibre module and gave its lumen-side volume as around 170 to 200 mL. That is the module in use then, so it does not by itself reconcile the 7.0 to 7.2 mL holdup weighed on 13 August.
note_zh: 約 200 mL 是實際量到的 lumen 體積而非估計值：Chars 於 5 月 13 日回報量測並清洗中空纖維模組，寫明其 lumen 側體積約為 170 至 200 mL。那是當時使用的模組，因此這一點本身並不能解釋 8 月 13 日秤得的 7.0 至 7.2 mL 持液量。

evidence.quote: The volume of hollow fiber module is around 170-200 mL (lumen side)

note_en: The 4 July hardware specification gives the ZP4000-N79H a flow range of 230 to 2600 mL/min. So 2,600 is the top of the vendor's flow range, not a dial number, and Biomanufacturing's phrase about a dial that goes to 2,600 misreads the spec. Nothing in Discord records the 1,535 mL/min trial at dial 100.
note_zh: 7 月 4 日的硬體規格把 ZP4000-N79H 的流量範圍寫為 230 至 2600 mL/min。因此 2,600 是廠商流量範圍的上限，而不是轉盤刻度，Biomanufacturing 所寫「轉盤可到 2,600」誤讀了規格。Discord 中沒有任何紀錄提到轉盤 100 時量到 1,535 mL/min。

evidence.quote: - Flow range: 230–2600 mL/min

note_en: Noah wrote the figure caption for this comparison on 5 September and states the median agreement directly: the raw photometer output agrees with the BioDrop reference to a median of 3.8%, which is why no calibration transform was applied. He is the member who did the photometer work.
note_zh: Noah 於 9 月 5 日撰寫這組比較的圖說，直接寫出中位差異：光度計的原始輸出與 BioDrop 參考值的中位差異為 3.8%，因此沒有套用任何校正轉換。他正是負責光度計工作的成員。

evidence.quote: the raw photometer output agrees with the reference to a median of 3.8% — so no calibration transform is applied

note_en: Noah's 5 September caption says both instruments track the TiO₂ standard at R² above 0.999 over the series, which is the Bioreactor and Photometer reading. He does not give the separate 0.9999 and 0.9998, and nothing in Discord mentions the 0.99 against 0.85 pair, which must come from the window above 30 mg.
note_zh: Noah 於 9 月 5 日的圖說寫明兩台儀器在整個序列上對 TiO₂ 標準品的 R² 都高於 0.999，與 Bioreactor 和 Photometer 頁的說法一致。他並未分別寫出 0.9999 與 0.9998，Discord 中也沒有 0.99 對 0.85 的那一組，後者應出自 30 mg 以上的視窗。

evidence.quote: Both track the standard at R² > 0.999

note_en: After the 10 October calibration the team describes the complex build the same way the Digital Twin does. Jacquelyn told Dr Pak on 12 October that the complex photometer is more linear at low OD and goes off at higher concentrations, and Timmy wrote the day before that V1 is shaky when OD gets high. That is against the Bioreactor page's claim of a trustworthy working range with no limit.
note_zh: 10 月 10 日的校正之後，團隊對複雜版的描述與 Digital Twin 一致。Jacquelyn 於 10 月 12 日告訴 Pak 博士，複雜版光度計在低 OD 較線性、濃度高時會偏掉；Timmy 前一天也寫下 V1 在 OD 偏高時不穩。這與 Bioreactor 頁所說整個工作範圍都可信賴、未設上限的說法相左。

evidence.quote: For the complex photometer, it seems  to be more linear at a low OD, and it beomes off at higher concentrations.
V1 more sheer light intensity, but shaky when OD gets high

note_en: Noah's 5 September caption confirms one of the two exclusions: the BioDrop point at 5 mg was dropped for a monotonicity violation and plotted as a grey open marker. The 37 mg handling error in Test 1 is not mentioned anywhere in Discord.
note_zh: Noah 於 9 月 5 日的圖說證實其中一項排除：BioDrop 在 5 mg 的點因違反單調性而剔除，並以灰色空心標記呈現。至於 Test 1 中 37 mg 因操作失誤排除一事，Discord 中完全沒有提到。

evidence.quote: One BioDrop point (mg 5) is excluded for a monotonicity violation (grey open marker).

note_en: The SiO₂ comparison of the two photometers did run on 10 October. Timmy announced both photometers running the final calibration test that afternoon and shared the live sheet, and jacquelyn confirmed the axes as SiO2 mass against sampled OD600. The Development, Bioreactor and Measurement wordings that call it ongoing or not measured are stale.
note_zh: 兩台光度計的 SiO₂ 比較確實在 10 月 10 日進行。Timmy 當天下午公告兩台光度計正在跑最後一次校正測試並分享即時試算表，jacquelyn 也確認座標為加入的 SiO2 質量對取樣的 OD600。Development、Bioreactor 與 Measurement 中仍寫成進行中或尚未量測的說法已經過時。

evidence.quote: Our 2 photometers are running our final Calibration Test.
x axis is how much SiO2 (mg) added and y axis is the OD600 sampled

note_en: The roughly five-fold factor was seen live during the 10 October run and puzzled the team: Noah asked why the OD is a fifth of the BioDrop value and jacquelyn put it down to the weaker light intensity of the simple build. That supports the scale of the 5.573 conversion but no one in Discord gives the fitted coefficients.
note_zh: 大約五倍的比例是 10 月 10 日實驗當下就看到的，也讓團隊困惑：Noah 問為何 OD 只有 BioDrop 的五分之一，jacquelyn 歸因於簡化版光強較弱。這支持 5.573 這個換算的量級，但 Discord 中沒有人給出擬合係數。

evidence.quote: idk why the od is 1/5 of the biodrop balue
light intensity weaker --> ratio ~1/5

note_en: The ranking of noise matches what the team saw on 10 October. Jacquelyn watched the simple unit settle faster and stay steady while the complex one kept fluctuating, and Timmy summed up V2 as lower intensity but more stable. That is the qualitative counterpart of the slim build's smaller noise figure; no numbers were posted.
note_zh: 雜訊的高低順序與團隊 10 月 10 日所見一致。Jacquelyn 觀察到簡化版穩定得較快且維持平穩，複雜版則持續跳動；Timmy 也把 V2 歸結為光強較低但較穩定。這是簡化版雜訊較小的定性對應，但現場沒有貼出任何數值。

evidence.quote: The simple one was a lot more steady, though like when we added the sample, it would even out faster, whereas the more complex thermometer would keep fluctuating
V2 lower light intensity, but more stable, ane less sensitivity so might miss small turbulance

note_en: Noah, describing the unit measured on 10 October to Dr Pak two days later, says the one thing they changed is that the light reaching the reference sensor now matches the intensity at the sample sensor. He therefore describes the measured build as still having a reference channel, which sits against the single-beam description on Photometer 5.3.
note_zh: Noah 在兩天後向 Pak 博士描述 10 月 10 日所測的那台時說，他們唯一改動的是送到參考感測器的光強現在與樣品感測器相當。換言之他描述的受測版本仍有參考通道，與 Photometer 5.3 所寫的單光束、無參考感測器相左。

evidence.quote: the only key thing we changed is that the light intensity sent to our reference sensor is now equivalent to the intensity of our sample sensor in which the light first passes through the solution before hitting the sensor itself

note_en: Chars's messages of 19 July carry three of the four claims: the reading overestimated by about four fold, he suspected the blank because he could not clean the flow cuvette, and after adding manual blank entry the reading came out a little lower than the BioDrop at 0.100 against 0.149. What the cuvette held is described in the same thread as titanium dioxide, so the live-culture part of the wiki sentence is not supported here.
note_zh: Chars 於 7 月 19 日的訊息涵蓋其中三項：讀值高估約四倍；他懷疑是空白值，因為無法在歸零前清潔流動比色管；加入手動輸入空白值後，讀值略低於 BioDrop，為 0.100 對 0.149。同一串討論中描述管內是二氧化鈦，因此維基所寫「首次讀取活菌培養液」在此得不到支持。

evidence.quote: Looks like it overestimates around 4-fold
But the problem might be on the blank. I cannot clean the flow cuvette before I blank it.
It turns out that the reading is a little bit lower than biodrop (0.100 and 0.149)

note_en: Timmy announced the purchase in the software channel on 2 October: he had got the team a set of hardware for a leaf temperature and wetness sensor and had written it up on a bench page. That fixes the date the hardware was obtained.
note_zh: Timmy 於 10 月 2 日在 software 頻道公告這次採購：他為團隊取得一組「葉片溫度與濕潤度感測器」硬體，並已把內容寫在一個測試網頁上。這確定了取得硬體的日期。

evidence.quote: So i got ourselves a set of hardware for "Leaf Temperature and Wetness Sensor".
